facts.fact: 门上血痕、走廊尽头 Veronica 的头（无眼无肉）——「I want my mother's forgiveness, her dependency. I still want her to want me even if she cannot love me.」
facts.anchor: I still want her to want me even if she cannot love me.

facts.fact: 悬崖尖叫：她学母亲的怪物声、撕破黄裙抓喉咙——「I am in tatters, fractured, little pieces of me failing to fit anywhere.」
facts.anchor: It is a sound that mimics my mother

facts.fact: Oren 悬崖到场：「What did she do?」「Nothing I did not deserve.」；自责：「She clawed herself free...Alone. I was not there...instead I was fucking you.」
Oren 揽罪：「Then blame me!...shove it in me, let me take it from you.」；悬崖吻（雷、鸥、雨）——「He is gentle and soft and mine.」
facts.anchor: “If it lifts the sorrow from your face, I will have it.”

facts.fact: 「I have to go home.」Oren 不问缘由——「he inches further into my heart. He settles there, among my mother, and although it is heavy, it does not hurt.」；时段约定：「Give me the hours after dawn and the ones before dusk...in ruins or in splendor, bloodied or fair. Just come to me.」
facts.anchor: He settles there, among my mother

facts.fact: 地土草草（她没等 Rue）——手按坟堆回应的是空洞与鼠爪声——「A hollowness answers, a stark absence that I have never encountered before.」
挖土见母：「You came back to me. My darling.」「Forgive me.」「Always.」——宽恕条款=回来就好
facts.anchor: “If you come back to me, I will always forgive you, my darling girl.”

facts.fact: 母亲认罪+鼠群复仇：催眠曲教鼠群 Ladies 血的味道——「It will fill their throats and their mouths and spill over. They will choke on it, darling...They will not die hungry.」
鼠群如瘟疫涌出直奔 Ladies——「I watch the rats go without a word, without guilt. They too can be victims of my mother’s fractious whims. I am tired.」
facts.anchor: They too can be victims of my mother’s fractious whims.
